runtime_failure_taxonomies.nature: Infrastructure Gateway Outage during service restart
runtime_failure_taxonomies.symptom: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway emitted directly by Nginx reverse proxy
runtime_failure_taxonomies.root_cause: During auto-deploy CI/CD, 'systemctl restart toanaas-web.service' briefly drops uvicorn listening socket (1-3s). Nginx receives '111: Connection refused' when forwarding traffic to 127.0.0.1:8000.
runtime_failure_taxonomies.remediation: Configure Nginx proxy_next_upstream (error timeout http_502 non_idempotent) and transition to zero-downtime graceful reload (gunicorn/uvicorn worker reload or socket activation).

runtime_failure_taxonomies.nature: Upstream Bot Bridge Missing Route (Not an Nginx 502)
runtime_failure_taxonomies.symptom: Browser receives HTTP 200 with guarded error payload or guarded envelope containing CORE_BRIDGE_NOT_AVAILABLE
runtime_failure_taxonomies.root_cause: Web App copyfast_bridge calls Bot Core at http://127.0.0.1:8080/internal/v1/admin/*. Bot Core bot.py only implements /internal/v1/admin/wallet/credit and /compensate. All other admin read endpoints return upstream HTTP 404, which copyfast_bridge maps to a guarded envelope.
runtime_failure_taxonomies.remediation: Cross-repo Bot task (manhtoangreensky-wq/bot) to implement canonical read-only authenticated admin endpoints in bot.py.

runtime_failure_taxonomies.nature: Application State Contract (Not an Nginx 502, Not a Gateway Failure)
runtime_failure_taxonomies.symptom: Browser receives HTTP 409 Conflict with error code ACCOUNT_TELEGRAM_UNLINKED
runtime_failure_taxonomies.root_cause: User authenticated via Email/Password has not linked their Telegram ID. Web App requires telegram_id to look up wallet balance in Bot SQLite database.
runtime_failure_taxonomies.remediation: Web App UX improvement (toan-aas-standalone) to render clear Telegram deep-link card and 6-digit OTP pairing UI instead of raw error toast.
